plain: An official order issued by a ruler or authority.

webster.text: That which is uttered or proclaimed by authority as a rule of action; an order issued by a prince to his subjects, as a rule or law requiring obedience; a proclamation of command or prohibition.

example.quote: The want of responsibility to the people from their representatives would furnish matter of ample discussion.;, but! pass it over in silence, only observing that it. is a grand, and indeed a daring fault, and one which sanctions with security the most tyrannic edicts of a despotic ruler.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
